scope: Remove unused passport-discord / passport; custom Discord OAuth remains canonical.
finding: Dashboard OAuth is implemented in src/dashboard/routes/auth.ts with custom Discord OAuth (state/PKCE). No src imports of passport or passport-discord existed.
decision: Removed direct dependencies passport, passport-discord and related @types. No auth rewrite required.

contracts.authPath: custom OAuth routes remain canonical (login/callback/logout + PKCE)

contracts.packageJson: passport and passport-discord absent from dependencies and devDependencies
